summary:
The agent failed despite appearing to succeed. The final verification shows the 'Inspection Index' bullet contains all four captions on one line ('Pier 4 - East Face
South Pump Station
Substation 2 - Roof Hatch
North Seawall - Expansion Joint') instead of four separate bullet points. This suggests the text replacement didn't properly create separate paragraphs. The existing archive-photo-caption-cleanup skill correctly warns about using ONE text frame with multiple paragraphs for Archive Sheet creation, but this task involved editing an existing slide's bullets, not creating a new one. The skill needs updating with: (1) guidance on editing existing bullet lists vs creating new ones, (2) explicit handling for replacing placeholder bullets with properly separated items, (3) stronger verification steps for bullet list structure. No new skill needed - this is a variant of the existing caption cleanup workflow.
